scenes.title: El Grito en el Zócalo
scenes.subject: Mexico City's Zócalo at night on Independence Day: the Metropolitan Cathedral with its two bell towers lit in red, white and green, a giant Mexican flag on the tall flagpole in the middle of the plaza, a cheerful crowd below holding small flags, colorful fireworks bursting in the night sky
scenes.motion: The giant flag waves proudly, red, white and green fireworks burst and sparkle above the cathedral, and the crowd cheers and waves their small flags.

scenes.title: Mariachi en Garibaldi
scenes.subject: A mariachi band playing in Plaza Garibaldi at night: musicians in black charro suits with silver buttons and wide sombreros playing trumpets, violins, guitars, a vihuela and a big guitarrón, warm plaza lights and papel picado overhead
scenes.motion: The mariachis play with joy, trumpets raised and violin bows moving, swaying to the rhythm and smiling at each other.

scenes.title: Tulum
scenes.subject: The Tulum ruins: the stone El Castillo temple on a limestone cliff above a turquoise Caribbean sea, a white sand beach and palm trees, a pink and gold sunrise sky
scenes.motion: Gentle turquoise waves roll onto the white beach, the palm trees sway, seabirds glide past and the sunrise glows warmer.

scenes.title: Guelaguetza — Flor de Piña
scenes.subject: The Guelaguetza festival in Oaxaca: a group of women dancing the Flor de Piña in long colorful embroidered huipiles and skirts, each carrying a pineapple on her shoulder, on an open-air stage with festive decorations
scenes.motion: The dancers step and sway together in a joyful circle, lifting their pineapples high, their embroidered skirts swinging.

scenes.title: Palenque
scenes.subject: The Temple of the Inscriptions at Palenque: a Maya stepped pyramid with a temple on top, surrounded by lush green jungle with soft morning mist and a small waterfall, two colorful toucans perched on a branch
scenes.motion: Mist drifts slowly through the jungle, the waterfall sparkles, and the toucans hop and flutter playfully in front of the temple.

scenes.title: Xochimilco
scenes.subject: Brightly painted trajineras (flat wooden boats with arches decorated with painted flowers and patterns, no lettering) floating on a green canal in Xochimilco, a mariachi band playing on one boat, families smiling and waving, flowers everywhere, sunny day
scenes.motion: The trajineras glide slowly along the canal, the mariachis play and sway, people wave and laugh, and flower petals float on the water.

scenes.title: Jarabe Tapatío
scenes.subject: The Jarabe Tapatío: a charro in a black embroidered suit and a china poblana in a sparkling red and green sequined skirt dancing joyfully around a wide charro sombrero on the floor of a festive stage
scenes.motion: The couple dances the zapateado around the sombrero, her skirt swirling in wide colorful waves, his hands behind his back, both smiling.

scenes.title: Barrancas del Cobre — El Chepe
scenes.subject: The Copper Canyon in Chihuahua: deep layered canyons in orange, red and green under a blue sky, and the El Chepe passenger train crossing a high bridge over the canyon
scenes.motion: The Chepe train rolls steadily across the bridge, soft clouds drift and an eagle glides over the canyon.

scenes.title: Parachicos de Chiapa de Corzo
scenes.subject: Parachicos dancers of Chiapa de Corzo during the Fiesta Grande: traditional carved wooden masks, tall headdresses of golden ixtle fiber, colorful striped serapes and embroidered shawls, metal rattles (chinchines) in their hands, confetti in the air
scenes.motion: The parachicos dance and hop joyfully, shaking their rattles, their golden headdresses bouncing as confetti falls.

scenes.title: Callejoneada en Guanajuato
scenes.subject: Guanajuato at dusk: hills covered with houses painted bright yellow, blue, pink and orange, church towers and a basilica dome, and a narrow cobblestone alley where an estudiantina of musicians in old Spanish-style costumes with capes and ribbons play guitars and mandolins
scenes.motion: The estudiantina musicians stroll and play joyfully, the ribbons on their capes swinging, as warm lights twinkle on in the colorful houses.

scenes.title: Escaramuza charra
scenes.subject: An escaramuza charra team: women riding horses side-saddle in a charro arena, wearing bright Adelita dresses with ruffled skirts and wide sombreros, riding together in a graceful synchronized formation, golden afternoon light
scenes.motion: The riders canter together in a graceful synchronized curve, their bright skirts flowing and sombreros steady, as dust sparkles in the sunlight.

scenes.title: El Arco de Cabo San Lucas
scenes.subject: El Arco, the natural rock arch at Land's End in Cabo San Lucas: golden rocks rising from a deep blue sea, a humpback whale leaping out of the water nearby, a warm sunset sky
scenes.motion: The humpback whale breaches joyfully with a big splash and dives back, waves sparkle, and pelicans glide past the arch.

scenes.title: Mercado mexicano
scenes.subject: A lively Mexican market: stalls piled with colorful fruits, chilies and flowers, piñatas hanging overhead, a smiling woman making tortillas on a hot comal, cheerful shoppers, warm light
scenes.motion: The tortillera pats and flips tortillas on the comal as steam rises, the piñatas sway gently, and shoppers chat and smile.

scenes.title: Concheros — danza azteca
scenes.subject: Concheros (Aztec dancers) performing in a plaza: dancers in red and gold costumes with tall colorful feather headdresses and shell ankle rattles, a drummer playing a huehuetl drum, swirling copal smoke
scenes.motion: The dancers spin and stomp in rhythm, their tall feather headdresses swaying, the drummer beats the huehuetl and copal smoke swirls.

scenes.title: Las Posadas
scenes.subject: Las Posadas at night in a Mexican courtyard: smiling children in sweaters cheering around a colorful star piñata hanging from a rope, one blindfolded child holding a decorated stick, paper lanterns, string lights and red poinsettias
scenes.motion: The piñata swings on its rope as the children laugh, cheer and jump, the blindfolded child swings playfully at it, and the lanterns sway.

scenes.title: Día de Reyes — Rosca
scenes.subject: Día de Reyes: a happy Mexican family around a kitchen table sharing a large oval Rosca de Reyes decorated with candied fruit, cups of steaming hot chocolate, a warm cozy kitchen
scenes.motion: The family laughs together and passes slices of the rosca, steam rises from the hot chocolate, and a child cheers.

scenes.title: La ofrenda de Día de Muertos
scenes.subject: A traditional Day of the Dead ofrenda (altar) with several tiers: glowing candles, orange cempasúchil marigolds, pan de muerto, colorful sugar skulls, papel picado banners, copal incense, fruit and a cup of hot chocolate, no photographs
scenes.motion: Candle flames flicker warmly, copal smoke curls upward, the papel picado flutters and a few marigold petals drift down.

scenes.title: Noche de Muertos en Janitzio
scenes.subject: Day of the Dead night on Lake Pátzcuaro: the island of Janitzio glowing with candles, fishermen in small wooden canoes holding the famous butterfly-shaped fishing nets, hundreds of candles reflecting on the dark water, orange marigolds
scenes.motion: Candles flicker and their reflections shimmer on the lake, the fishermen gently dip and raise their butterfly nets like wings, and the canoes drift slowly.
